name: calle-design-catalog
policy: Free MIT source is vendored under components/external so you can read and import it. BoardUI Pro is paid and is indexed only — no Pro source is included. Prefer components/ui and components/kit for Calle UI, then import from local_path. Apply tokens in app/globals.css.

local_kit.note: Calle UI lives in components/ui and components/kit. Free EasyUI and BoardUI source lives in components/external, one library per folder. Open local_path from this catalog.

sources.license: MIT for free components. Pro components and templates require a paid license.
sources.install_pro: npx boardui@latest login && npx boardui@latest add <name> --yes
